title: Resolve external pose-driver interface and add minimal pose-driver harness
description:
## Summary
Resolve the external pose-driver interface and add a minimal pose-driver harness without broadening into locomotion or a second animation framework.

## User Mandate
STRICT
- Fixed point: current main head in this workspace; this is sequential round 2 of a 5-round sprint and the source tree is the source of truth.
- Owning task: TSK-0133 — Resolve external pose-driver interface and add minimal pose-driver harness.
- Acceptance criteria:
  - A decision record names the chosen external driver interface and the rejected alternative with rationale.
  - A minimal PlayMode spike proves the chosen driver moves a real bone or posed mesh one frame.
  - No internal animator locomotion state machine, gait system, or animation clip subsystem is added.
- Scope and stop boundary:
  - Only touch the external pose-driver contract, a minimal harness, and relevant tests/docs.
  - The driver can be direct indexed pose application through CreatureRig.ApplyPose(PosedSkeleton) or a Unity Animator/Avatar route if there is a strong reason; choose one and document the rationale.
  - Do not broaden into locomotion or full animation-system architecture.
  - Do not commit or push.
- Hypothesis:
  - A direct indexed pose interface is the correct MVP path because it keeps the external rig simple, deterministic, and compatible with the existing rig contract without a Unity Avatar build pipeline.
- Discriminating check:
  - A minimal PlayMode posed-mesh or bone-motion harness proves the chosen boundary moves the creature in a single frame under the existing rig API.
- Validation gate:
  - dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore
  - dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore
  - focused PlayMode harness for the picked driver interface
  - git diff --check
- Repo contract:
  - CreatureDefinition remains authoritative DNA; runtime code under Assets/Scripts/Runtime has no scene-object/editor dependency.
  - The external rig is intentionally out of scope; this task only defines the driver boundary and a minimal test harness.
  - Keep the implementation minimal and explicit; no second animation framework.
- Required report format:
  - Owning task key
  - Changed files
  - Exact commands + results
  - What passed / did not pass / blockers
  - Residual risk and next step
  - Non-obvious design decisions explicitly called out
- Follow Assets/Scripts/README.md, creature-workflow, engineering-guardrails, and unity-validation. Do not attach broad commentary or speculative notes; keep it precise and evidence-driven.

## Scope
- Decide the external pose-driver boundary and keep it minimal and explicit.
- Add a minimal PlayMode test harness that proves the chosen driver moves a real bone or posed mesh one frame.
- Record the decision and rationale in the ADR stream and keep the work scoped to the external contract + harness + relevant docs/tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A decision record names the chosen external driver interface and the rejected alternative with rationale.
- A minimal PlayMode spike proves the chosen driver moves a real bone or posed mesh one frame.
- No internal animator locomotion state machine, gait system, or animation clip subsystem is added.

## Validation
- dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore
- dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore
- focused PlayMode harness for the chosen direct indexed pose interface
- git diff --check
